body:
stdlib/editor/textmate_loader.prn: real TextMate grammar JSON interpreter (flat match-only patterns, begin/end honestly out of scope). stdlib/editor/lang_json.prn: first real language mod built on it. Wired into examples/editor_main.c for real .json syntax highlighting. Found and fixed 3 real top-level name collisions getting json.prn+array.prn+regex/syntax.prn+expr.prn to compile together for the first time (parse/get/skip-ws/parse-number). 15 new real end-to-end assertions, zero regressions across the full local suite. Also closed a real, recurring CI gap (2nd occurrence in PARENA's own CI): extracted examples/editor-demo-sources.txt as a single shared file list for both the Makefile and ci.yml, replacing two hand-maintained copies that kept drifting. CI green on all 4 jobs, run 33145402396. Commits 45a0b51, d612408.

⚓ ☃
title: Real .tmLanguage.json grammar loader + first language mod (JSON) + editor wiring
